pages.text: The Biomass Press squeezes $(l)organic waste$() into $(item)Biomass$(). Biomass is the solid mash a $(l:generators/bio_digester)Bio-Digester$(/l) turns into Biogas, the first gas fuel. Biomass is also a weak fertilizer.

$(li)Place the press, then a $(l:basics/cyber_frame)Cyber Frame$(/l) $(l)on top of it$().$(br)$(li)With the frame there it assembles into a press two blocks tall. It only works once assembled.$(br)$(li)Connect power with $(l:cables/energy_conduit)Energy Conduits$(/l), to the machine block or to its frame.
pages.title: Building it

pages.text: $(li)It accepts $(l)anything a composter takes$() (seeds, crops, leaves, saplings, flowers...) and $(l)rotten flesh$().$(br)$(li)Feed it by hand, or with a hopper: through the funnel on top, or from the sides of its lower block.
pages.title: Using it

pages.text: $(li)The $(l)nozzle on its right$(), as you face its open front, pushes the Biomass into the container there: a hopper, a chest or a Bio-Digester.$(br)$(li)A hopper under the press, or a $(l:drone_systems/modules)Transport$(/l) drone, can also take the Biomass. They never take the waste still to press.
$(li)The mash in its chamber rises with what is inside, up to a full stack.$(br)$(li)It takes Speed, Efficiency and Battery $(l:drone_systems/addons)addons$(/l) on the tab beside its GUI.

$(li)$(l)Power$(): 8 FE/t$(br)$(li)$(l)Time per item$(): 2 seconds$(br)$(li)$(l)Yield$(): twice the item's composter chance, on average$(br)$(l)Richer waste gives more Biomass:$()$(br)$(li)$(l)Seeds, leaves, saplings, grass$(): 0.6$(br)$(li)$(l)Cactus, vines, melon slices, sugar cane$(): 1
pages.title: Numbers

pages.text: $(li)$(l)Wheat, carrots, potatoes, apples, flowers, pumpkins$(): 1.3$(br)$(li)$(l)Rotten flesh$(): 1.6$(br)$(li)$(l)Hay bales, baked potatoes, bread$(): 1.7$(br)$(li)$(l)Cake, pumpkin pie$(): 2
The recipe viewer (JEI or REI) lists every item with its yield. A press fed with wheat keeps about one and a half Bio-Digesters busy.

Use Biomass on a plant by hand, or load it in a dock for a $(l:drone_systems/modules)Fertilizer$(/l) drone. It is always used up, but grows the plant only $(l)one time in three$(). Bone meal goes further.
pages.title: Biomass as fertilizer

pages.text: $(li)Without power the press waits and keeps its progress.$(br)$(li)Point the nozzle straight at a Bio-Digester for a fully automatic biogas line.
